findings: B-REVERIFY-1R: absolute/relative source path resolution, held-anchor traversal, same-FD post-copy verification, parent replacement, and same-inode mutation were not executable.
B-REVERIFY-3R: VACUUM INTO and generated SQLite files had no enforceable pre-write maxSnapshotBytes boundary.
B-REVERIFY-4R: rollback lacked per-final identity guards, durable ordering, and crash/orphan-journal behavior.
B-GATE-1: status and scripts could claim or report later-phase evidence while P1/P2 remained unaccepted and absent suites passed with passWithNoTests.
B-LEGACY-PUB-1: legacy output retained path-based mkdir/temp/rename and a cross-device copy fallback despite user-controlled outputDir.

required_controls.source: Held no-follow anchors and member descriptors are required for absolute and relative paths; copy and post-copy digest/fstat use the same descriptors; unsafe traversal fails before SQLite.
required_controls.snapshot: materializationQuota.ts computes and reserves a finite page/WAL-derived bound before writable SQLite work; real materialization tests supplement, but injected budget events cannot substitute for, this gate.
required_controls.rollback: Descriptor-relative fsynced journals record staged/published/backup identities; rollback is identity guarded; interruption or external mutation retains recovery state and returns OUTPUT_RECOVERY_REQUIRED/exit 6.
required_controls.legacy: Output-bearing legacy calls use the same Linux native no-follow descriptor-relative publication matrix; path and cross-device fallbacks are forbidden.
required_controls.dispatch: phase-dispatch-check.mjs requires fresh blocking P1/P2 evidence, exact named suites, no passWithNoTests, and refuses P3/P4 otherwise.

frozen_decisions: Snapshot acquisition captures the exact present main, -wal, and -shm members before SQLite extraction; copied bundle bytes use fixed member order and explicit presence markers for the physical hash.
WAL replay and VACUUM INTO occur only in private copied state; immutable=1 is used only for extraction of the materialized main-only file, with no live-read fallback.
The public row API is iterateRawCards(...): AsyncIterableIterator<RawCardRows>; a synchronous public iterator is not provided.
Modern discovery accepts only an exact final .cdb extension and has a separate symlink/relative-exclude policy from legacy first-dot basename discovery.

Phase P2 is checkpoint-complete-but-not-contract-accepted; prior artifacts are preserved where they pass, every P2 criterion and every applicable invariant remains an active proof requirement, and completed_phase_ids remains empty until this phase gate is accepted.

Capture the main and every present -wal/-shm member, copy and hash the exact fixed canonical JSON [main, -wal, -shm] representation with bytesBase64 and explicit absent nulls, re-stat/re-hash originals before any SQLite open, and never open originals for extraction.

Before selecting any text value, require PRAGMA encoding exactly UTF-8 (otherwise UNSUPPORTED_DATABASE_ENCODING, exit 4), check typeof before byte length, select retained text as CAST(column AS BLOB), decode with TextDecoder("utf-8", {fatal:true}), and never select an oversized text value; invalid text/storage/encoding is exit 4.

maxSnapshotBytes is the aggregate private snapshot/materialization budget for copied source members, materialized main, and generated private SQLite files/temp siblings; the copied source-bundle sum is only an early check, every copy/write chunk reserves before writing and reconciles actual growth, and maxSnapshotBytes > maxStagingBytes and maxSpoolBytes > maxStagingBytes are reject-only INVALID_LIMIT_RELATION errors (exit 2) before discovery/input access; snapshot/materialized/private writes reserve once per physical file, reconcile actual growth, and release once.

sourceHandle is the named P2 lifecycle boundary. Snapshot hashing is incrementally streamed; the input parent is traversed through no-symlink descriptor-relative primitives; each source member is held with O_NOFOLLOW|O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC, fstat-verified against lstat, and copied/hashed from that descriptor; source path copying is forbidden. VACUUM INTO paths use a verified SQLite literal; extraction uses uri:true, immutable=1, and defaultSafeIntegers(); generated private journal/WAL/SHM files are reserved/reconciled/cleaned.

P2 staging evidence covers only snapshot, materialized, generated-private SQLite, and isolated legacy output state plus a generic budget contract; merge spool/index/lineage accounting and modern conversion lifecycle are deferred to P3/P4.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A stable WAL input yields committed rows through copied-bundle replay and private materialization while original regular main/WAL/SHM members remain unchanged and extraction creates no source sidecar. Unsupported option combinations fail with exit 2 before discovery/opening; exit 3 requires !hasUsableInput and !inputAccessStarted with no input/strict/resource/collision/output/cancellation/internal failure; output/cancellation is exit 6; input/resource/strict/integer failure is exit 4 when output is clean; collision is exit 5 when output and input are clean; mixed continued failure is exit 7; unexpected internal failure is exit 1; otherwise success is exit 0.
Existing split output roots are rejected even when empty and --force does not override that rule.

Stdout is allowed only for one logical output and is intentionally non-atomic; file and directory logical units are private-staged and atomic, and a no-continue multi-output run is published through a reserved commit-set journal with reverse rollback (including force-backup restoration) on between-final failure.
Unavailable secure-destination capability returns UNSAFE_DESTINATION_FILESYSTEM and never activates a path-based file writer.

deferred: Text segmentation and ygo.card-source/1 document generation.
Downstream translator semantics, rulings, scripts, legality, and executable effect interpretation.
frozen_decisions: No decoder precedence is allowed for conflicting primary kind, subtype, or progression flags; use UNKNOWN or null and retain complete ordered arrays and diagnostics.
Unknown bits and raw masks remain in the output; ot is availability metadata and category is not an effect tag.
Merge ordering consumes reader canonical IDs, source ordinals, and input order without re-sorting or numeric coercion.
A merged error collision is global and terminal with exit 5; first and last retain all contributing source lineage.

phases.name: source-streaming
phases.goal: Produce conservative ygo.card-source/1 documents and prove generic consumption, normalized UTF-16 spans, streaming equivalence, cancellation cleanup, and provenance determinism.
bounded_discovery: Inspect only text normalization/segmentation, source mapping, hashing, serialization, pilot consumer, and named streaming tests.
Treat the 64 stable pilot IDs and the generic consumer fixture as the bounded contract corpus; do not import a downstream DSL repository or add unreviewed semantic rules.
in_scope: Normalize CRLF/CR to LF and NFC while retaining exact raw text and inclusive/exclusive UTF-16 spans into normalized text.
Map normalized card records into ygo.card-source/1 with null orphan states, raw rows, physical provenance, SOURCE_ONLY coverage, empty default external references, and diagnostics.
Validate exactly 64 pilot records through a generic JSON/JSONL schema consumer with no CDB or SQLite dependency.
Make unmerged writers incremental and backpressure-aware, distinguish stdout partial behavior from file atomicity, and prove source-revision/conversion-option hash inclusion and exclusion vectors.
deferred: Implementing any DSL translator, executable effect semantics, rulings, or script references.
Changing the accepted source schema identifier without a contract revision and regenerated pilot.
frozen_decisions: text.raw is exact source text; text.normalized uses text-normalization/1, and serialized spans use the frozen text.sections/text.sourceSpans layout. Every slice requires copied text, inclusive start, exclusive end, kind, and basis: normalized; root text.spans and begin/end-only shapes are invalid.
Every source document has coverage.status SOURCE_ONLY and empty scripts/rulings unless a future declared source is supplied.

sourceRevisionId includes the verified physical bundle hash and source facts; conversionOptionsHash hashes the shared semantic-options object; presentation-only options are excluded from both. Physical-reorder comparisons use canonicalDataProjection(record), which excludes only the declared physical identity fields: sourceRevisionId and simulatorSource.database.sha256 for ygo.card-source/1 (identity.databaseSha256 is forbidden), and source.databaseSha256 for cdb.card/2; full records must differ only there.
Merged output is disk-backed two-pass and is not advertised as single-pass streaming.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Text normalization and segmentation preserve raw text, emit required normalization metadata, and serialize only the frozen text.sections/text.sourceSpans layout: every derived slice requires copied text, inclusive/exclusive start/end, kind, and basis: normalized, and round-trips against normalized UTF-16 code-unit offsets.
